old_findings.finding: Old equality of full owner dictionaries could accept a live same-PID/birth process after exec, or canonical type mismatch, as dead.
old_findings.current_rule: Death uses absent PID or different birth only. Current active camera still requires exact PID/birth/cmd pin equality. Canonical positive digit-string birth and lowercase SHA pin required.

old_findings.finding: Old preflight did not bind selected original reader/run config/Native source and operator closure/systemd entry to the actual active camera.
old_findings.current_rule: Fresh selected reader and original pinned metadata-only _verify, current owner config, full Native 222 manifest, operator 7, C-unit 6+ABI2, approved library, systemd properties and exact unit/drop-in paths+SHA are checked before stop.

checks.default_read_only: Default returns before tx.mkdir/create and calls only reads, metadata-only pinned _verify, original systemctl show and HTTP GET metadata. No explicit evidence/stage/checkpoint/marker/data write.
checks.gui_and_owner: Normally stopped GUI unit, nonempty prior GUI lifetimes dead, no GUI service cgroup processes; active camera unit and full owner match. Post-stop same lifetime must be absent and camera cgroup empty.
checks.stop_once: Only one subprocess argv is systemctl stop --no-block aura-camera-ui.service. No automatic retry or camera signal/kill/terminate.
checks.infinite_no_kill: Preflight requires Restart=no, SendSIGKILL=no, KillMode=process, TimeoutStopUSec=infinity. Local 25s observation does not change the unit timeout or force the camera.
checks.intent_and_preflight: Durable O_EXCL+fsync intent records fresh boot/source owner/startup/current monotonic lower bounds, SFace seven counters and complete optional state. Startup+active owner rechecked immediately before original stop submission.
checks.early_counter_hold: Before intent creation, optional yunet/sface each require nonnegative int calls/native_completed/native_failures/not_submitted/overruns; recovery faults/attempts/recoveries/probe_successes and bool history_opaque required. Missing key/type raises before directory/intent/stop.
checks.fresh_final: Original fixed checkpoint is read only after normal unit success, predecessor lifetime dead and cgroup empty. Exact final scope/purpose/kind, current boot/PID/birth, captured>=intent, primary/overrun+SFace lower bounds, no consumed marker and stable same bytes are required.
checks.markers_and_business_data: No write operation targets checkpoint, consumed marker, Native source/config, model, enrollment database, listening preference or GUI data.

fresh_linux_prerequisites: After explicit device handoff, acquire fresh current boot/owner canonical birth/cmd/startup and all closure pins. Historical a6d/1332/26pin observations are not fresh proof.
GUI must normally stop with no surviving prior lifetime/cgroup process, listening preference paused, enrollment_sampling.stage exactly idle and Native/camera healthy in original running domain.
Fresh actual API must provide all required optional and recovery cumulative fields. Do not fill missing calls/native_completed with zero or substitute last_report for a cumulative count.
Full Native original readback/history validation and required history anchor remain separate mandatory steps after fresh final; NEW_FINAL_PRESENT is not a full-reader pass.
operational_notes: An 8s subprocess.run timeout can terminate its systemctl CLI helper, not the camera service process. A failure after durable intent can leave intent without result. Reconcile read-only using that intent; do not blindly submit a second stop.
The helper does not itself prove every Native array, recovery/history chain, auxiliary quiescence or source header. Its fresh final result explicitly requires the full original validator.
The original operator wrapper migrates predecessor disk library/unit references in memory. Do not add a rule forcing the untouched original owner run config to directly name final 704f/7cf values.
New-boot archive-only loading belongs to the original Native loader domain. This same-boot normal-stop helper neither redoes bootstrap nor merges historical and fresh counter domains.
ready_for: Fresh Linux default dry-run only after current device owner explicitly hands back maintenance rights; --stop readiness depends on that successful fresh dry-run and planned full-reader/history adapter.
